t0293-01.gloss: Field residue and response material share one personal bundle.
t0293-01.rival_reading: Field work and a hurried emergency response could each explain the mixed residue and road tape; neither fixes which came first.

t0293-02.gloss: A scene-specific count or record was controlled while people were still present.
t0293-02.rival_reading: The same trace could follow an investigation of contaminated farm goods or an ordinary emergency response.
